RegistrationResponse.schema.json.description: Registration response parameters returned to a CBSD

cbsdId.description: Globally unique string generated by the SAS which identifies this CBSD.

measReportConfig.description: Contains any measurement indication the SAS requests the CBSD to perform and report in a subsequent request.

SpectrumInquiryResponse.schema.json.description: Spectrum Inquiry response returned to a CBSD

cbsdId.description: Unique designator for the CBSD as passed to the spectrum inquiry procedure.

availableChannel.description: An array of available channels returned by the SAS covered by the inquiredSpectrum array in the request.

availableChannelObject.description: Response from the SAS to an inquiry for available channels within a particular frequency range. Note that the frequency ranges in the response need not correspond to the frequency ranges in the request. Instead, the provided response frequency ranges describe possible channels for the CBSD.

channelType.description: The channel type corresponding to the associated frequency range, either PAL or GAA

ruleApplied.description: The rule applied in generating the channel availability list in this frequency range.

HeartbeatResponse.schema.json.description: Heartbeat response provided to a CBSD

cbsdId.description: Unique designator for the CBSD as passed in the heartbeat request.

grantId.description: Unique designator for the grant as passed in the heartbeat request.

transmitExpireTime.description: An RFC3339-formatted string indicating the time the CBSD can transmit until.

grantExpireTime.description: An RFC3339-formatted string indicating the expiry time of the CBSD grant.

heartbeatInterval.description: If present, the CBSD is required to use the indicated heartbeat interval in subsequent heartbeat requests.

RelinquishmentResponse.schema.json.description: Relinquishment response provided to a CBSD

cbsdId.description: Unique designator for the CBSD as provided in the relinquishment request.

grantId.description: Unique designator for the grant as provided in the relinquishment request.

DeregistrationResponse.schema.json.description: Deregistration response provided to a CBSD

cbsdId.description: Unique designator for the CBSD as provided in the deregistration request.

GrantResponse.schema.json.description: Spectrum Grant response message to the CBSD.

cbsdId.description: CBSD identifier as passed in the spectrum grant request.

grantId.description: A unique ID marking a spectrum grant originated from the SAS. If response.responseCode is non-zero, this must not be present.

grantExpireTime.description: RFC3339 date-time stamp indicating when the grant expires.

heartbeatInterval.description: Indicates an interval in seconds the CBSD should use between heartbeat requests.

channelType.description: Indication of whether the granted channel is a PAL or GAA channel

responseCode.description: An integer indicating the type of the response. 0 means success (no error)

responseMessage.description: A detailed human-readable string describing the response.

responseData.description: Additional response-dependent structured data containing more information about an error.

OperationParam.schema.json.description: Operational parameters provided for a CBSD

maxEirp.description: The peak operating power in dBm/MHz to be used by the CBSD within this operating parameter set

FrequencyRange.schema.json.description: Describes a frequency range. The range is provided as a pair of numbers which describe the bounding values of the range.

lowFrequency.description: The lower frequency of the range in Hz.

highFrequency.description: The higher frequency of the range in Hz. Must be greater than lowFrequency.

MeasReportConfig.schema.json.description: Measurement report configuration parameters. Indicates to a CBSD which spectrum measurement the SAS wishes it to perform.
